notes: All assets are authentic ORIBI South Africa and Groupe SOS PULSE media curated from oribi.org.za. High-resolution JPEGs in images/hi/ are cropped cleanly (no letterboxes or pillarboxes) and sized <= 450 KiB for fast local and web loading. media/oribi-ambient-loop.mp4 is a 18.76s, 3.08 MiB silent, letterbox-free, text-free FastStart ambient hero background loop cropped from the documentary footage. media/oribi-founder-reel.mp4 is the full 1080p FastStart founder documentary film with audio for the Watch founder film lightbox modal.
